match.supplier_regex: ^(BLACKPOOL COASTAL HOUSING|BLACKPOOL HOUSING COMPANY LTD|BLACKPOOL TRANSPORT SERVICES LTD|BLACKPOOL ENTERTAINMENT COMPANY LTD|BLACKPOOL AIRPORT OPERATIONS LTD)$

rules.reason: Blackpool Council wholly-owned subsidiaries — payments are between council and its own operating arms, not third-party procurement. BCH is the ALMO managing council housing stock; Blackpool Housing Company acquires/lets temporary accommodation; Blackpool Transport Services is the bus/tram operator (council-owned since 1986); Blackpool Airport Operations has been wholly-owned since the 2014 acquisition; Blackpool Entertainment Company is the leasehold landlord vehicle for the Tower and associated assets. Excluded from supplier-concentration + procurement-intensity metrics.
